arguments.text: 8000 m, 8 legs of 1000 m out-and-back. Pacer owns effort. Me: (1) watch instrument health: pod vs boat-model power ratio (eff_ratio) and heart rate vs pod power, to catch pod drift; (2) watch drag (push_local drops within a leg -> weed; pacer clears rudder, check it worked); (3) watch radio/paddler messages for course changes -> set_race_distance + tell; (4) check calibration of critical power from HR trend at steady effort mid-race. Baselines at min 4-8 of the race. Speak rarely.

arguments.name: eff_ratio
arguments.description: boat-model power over pod shaft power: drops with drag or a pod reading high

arguments.name: hr_per_shaft
arguments.description: heart rate per pod watt: falls if the pod reads high
